statement: Excluding the Rum agreement, Anthropic's compute deals over the past year total at least 14.8 gigawatts of capacity and could cost up to $517 billion over the next ten years.
why: A single model developer contracting nearly 15 gigawatts sets a floor under accelerator and power demand for years, far beyond any one quarter's order book.

impact.mechanism: Gigawatt-scale multi-year compute commitments must be filled with accelerators, racks, power and cooling, pulling demand across the chain over a decade.

evidence.excerpt: these arrangements total at least 14.8 gigawatts of compute capacity and could cost up to $517 billion over the next decade (ten years)

confidence.basis: Secondary aggregation of deals with counterparties including Google, SpaceX and Nscale; the dollar figure is an upper bound over ten years, not a contracted amount.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 13.7 -> 517.0 (tol 1%); sources: PYMNTS.com (citing The Information)
